title: OpenStack rabbitmq
description: Configuration for the RabbitMQ message bus (OpenStack-Helm rabbitmq, release 2025.1). Only the fields here are settable on a Composition; everything else uses the chart defaults in values.yaml. Deploy all the OpenStack component blueprints into one namespace to form a complete install.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: The PersistentVolumeClaim holding the broker's users, vhosts and durable queues. Read when the StatefulSet is first created: Kubernetes refuses a later change to it.

class_name.title: StorageClass
class_name.description: StorageClass for the claim. `default` leaves it unset, so the cluster's default class is used.

size.title: Size
size.description: Requested capacity, as a Kubernetes quantity.
